en.text: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

footnotes.text: 106:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要赞美耶和华！

zhTraditional.text: 你們要讚美耶和華！

en.text: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?

zhSimplified.text: 谁能传说耶和华的大能？

zhTraditional.text: 誰能傳說耶和華的大能？

en.text: Blessed are those who keep justice. is one who does what is right at all times.

zhSimplified.text: 凡遵守公平、常行公义的，

zhTraditional.text: 凡遵守公平、常行公義的，

en.text: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓；

en.text: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

zhSimplified.text: 使我见你选民的福，

zhTraditional.text: 使我見你選民的福，

en.text: We have sinned with our fathers. have committed iniquity. have done wickedly.

zhSimplified.text: 我们与我们的祖宗一同犯罪；

zhTraditional.text: 我們與我們的祖宗一同犯罪；

en.text: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

zhSimplified.text: 我们的祖宗在不明白你的奇事， 行了悖逆。

zhTraditional.text: 我們的祖宗在不明白你的奇事， 行了悖逆。

en.text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

zhSimplified.text: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他们，

zhTraditional.text: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他們，

en.text: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

zhSimplified.text: 并且斥责，海便干了；

zhTraditional.text: 並且斥責，海便乾了；

en.text: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

zhSimplified.text: 他拯救他们脱离恨他们人的手，

zhTraditional.text: 他拯救他們脫離恨他們人的手，

en.text: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

zhSimplified.text: 水淹没他们的敌人，

zhTraditional.text: 水淹沒他們的敵人，

en.text: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，他们才信了他的话，

zhTraditional.text: 那時，他們才信了他的話，

en.text: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,

zhSimplified.text: 等不多时，他们就忘了他的作为，

zhTraditional.text: 等不多時，他們就忘了他的作為，

en.text: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

zhSimplified.text: 反倒在旷野大起欲心，

zhTraditional.text: 反倒在曠野大起慾心，

en.text: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

zhSimplified.text: 他将他们所求的赐给他们，

zhTraditional.text: 他將他們所求的賜給他們，

en.text: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.

zhSimplified.text: 他们又在营中嫉妒 。

zhTraditional.text: 他們又在營中嫉妒 。

en.text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

zhSimplified.text: 地裂开，吞下， 一党的人。

zhTraditional.text: 地裂開，吞下， 一黨的人。

en.text: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

zhSimplified.text: 有火在他们的党中发起；

zhTraditional.text: 有火在他們的黨中發起；

en.text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在造了牛犊，

zhTraditional.text: 他們在造了牛犢，

en.text: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

zhSimplified.text: 如此将他们荣耀

zhTraditional.text: 如此將他們榮耀

en.text: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

zhSimplified.text: 忘了 神—他们的救主； 行大事，

zhTraditional.text: 忘了上帝－他們的救主； 行大事，

en.text: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

zhSimplified.text: 在地行奇事， 行可畏的事。

zhTraditional.text: 在地行奇事， 行可畏的事。

en.text: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，他说要灭绝他们； 站在当中，

zhTraditional.text: 所以，他說要滅絕他們； 站在當中，

en.text: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,

zhSimplified.text: 他们又藐视那美地，

zhTraditional.text: 他們又藐視那美地，

en.text: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.

zhSimplified.text: 在自己帐棚内发怨言，

zhTraditional.text: 在自己帳棚內發怨言，

en.text: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

zhSimplified.text: 所以，他对他们起誓：

zhTraditional.text: 所以，他對他們起誓：

en.text: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

zhSimplified.text: 叫他们的后裔倒在列国之中，

zhTraditional.text: 叫他們的後裔倒在列國之中，

en.text: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 他们又与连合， 的物。

zhTraditional.text: 他們又與連合， 的物。

en.text: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们这样行，惹耶和华发怒，

zhTraditional.text: 他們這樣行，惹耶和華發怒，

en.text: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，站起，刑罚恶人，

zhTraditional.text: 那時，站起，刑罰惡人，

en.text: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

zhSimplified.text: 那就算为他的义，

zhTraditional.text: 那就算為他的義，

en.text: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

zhSimplified.text: 他们在水又叫耶和华发怒， 也受了亏损，

zhTraditional.text: 他們在水又叫耶和華發怒， 也受了虧損，

en.text: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

zhSimplified.text: 是因他们惹动他的灵， 用嘴说了急躁的话。

zhTraditional.text: 是因他們惹動他的靈， 用嘴說了急躁的話。

en.text: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,

zhSimplified.text: 他们不照耶和华所吩咐的

zhTraditional.text: 他們不照耶和華所吩咐的

en.text: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

zhSimplified.text: 反与他们混杂相合，

zhTraditional.text: 反與他們混雜相合，

en.text: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

zhSimplified.text: 事奉他们的偶像，

zhTraditional.text: 事奉他們的偶像，

en.text: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

zhSimplified.text: 把自己的儿女祭祀鬼魔，

zhTraditional.text: 把自己的兒女祭祀鬼魔，

en.text: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and of their daughters, they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

zhSimplified.text: 流无辜人的血， 的偶像，

zhTraditional.text: 流無辜人的血， 的偶像，

en.text: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

zhSimplified.text: 这样，他们被自己所做的污秽了，

zhTraditional.text: 這樣，他們被自己所做的污穢了，

en.text: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，耶和华的怒气向他的百姓发作，

zhTraditional.text: 所以，耶和華的怒氣向他的百姓發作，

en.text: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

zhSimplified.text: 将他们交在外邦人的手里；

zhTraditional.text: 將他們交在外邦人的手裏；

en.text: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

zhSimplified.text: 他们的仇敌也欺压他们，

zhTraditional.text: 他們的仇敵也欺壓他們，

en.text: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

zhSimplified.text: 他屡次搭救他们，

zhTraditional.text: 他屢次搭救他們，

en.text: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

zhSimplified.text: 然而，他听见他们哀告的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 然而，他聽見他們哀告的時候，

en.text: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

zhSimplified.text: 为他们记念他的约，

zhTraditional.text: 為他們記念他的約，

en.text: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

zhSimplified.text: 他也使他们在凡掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤。

zhTraditional.text: 他也使他們在凡擄掠他們的人面前蒙憐恤。

en.text: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我们的 神啊，求你拯救我们，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我們的上帝啊，求你拯救我們，

en.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—的 神是应当称颂的，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－的上帝是應當稱頌的，
